In the presence of tight deadlines, there may be insufficient time to complete the search for a plan before it is time to act.\\nOne can gain additional time to search by starting to act before a complete plan is found, incurring the risk of making incorrect action choices.\\nThis tradeoff between opportunity and risk,\\ninherent in interleaving planning and\\nexecution, is a non-trivial metareasoning problem addressed in this paper.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1609/socs.v12i1.18572\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2021, 7, 21]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.7551/mitpress/8069.003.0013\", \"title\": [\"Metareasoning, Monitoring, and Self-Explanation\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.7551/mitpress/8069.003.0013\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2011, 3, 18]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.7551/mitpress/8069.003.0025\", \"title\": [\"Anthropomorphic Self-Models for Metareasoning Agents\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.7551/mitpress/8069.003.0025\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2011, 3, 18]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.7551/mitpress/9780262014809.003.0009\", \"title\": [\"Metareasoning, Monitoring, and Self-Explanation\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.7551/mitpress/9780262014809.003.0009\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2011, 3, 18]]}}]", "excerpt_truncated": false, "source_sha256": "da3cd89f72fd67abf44c1343f168c541e0153b961cbb47a6d546bae365be2eeb", "verification_required": true, "topic_domain": "assumption_challenge", "evidence_role": "discovery", "host_tier": "discovery", "source_identity": null, "persistent_identifiers": ["doi:10.1609/socs.v12i1.18572", "doi:10.7551/mitpress/8069.003.0013", "doi:10.7551/mitpress/8069.003.0025", "doi:10.7551/mitpress/9780262014809.003.0009"], "source_candidates": ["https://doi.org/10.1609/socs.v12i1.18572", "https://doi.org/10.7551/mitpress/8069.003.0013", "https://doi.org/10.7551/mitp…
